alternative.meaning: A timing-diagram account uses six symbolic connector sleeves to separate a command from its observation, without inventing timing, cause or resolution, and closes on sample and qualification limits.

1 / Timing diagram · Command

Ada Mensah. Follow code to the bench.

What can a physical signal tell you about firmware?

My working documents are a state table, timing diagram and current trace. For Mosslink, I wrote firmware, scheduled power states and built a bring-up fixture.

Six connector sleeves form a symbolic probe assembly. Position indicates conceptual order, not duration, wiring or a measured signal.

Email Ada · Read the conclusion

2 / Timing diagram · Observation

An observation, without an invented ending.

After a failed transmission, a current trace showed the radio remaining awake. This sketch separates a conceptual command path from its observation. No actual trace, timing, cause or resolution is shown.

Six connector sleeves form a symbolic probe assembly. Position indicates conceptual order, not duration, wiring or a measured signal.

3 / Timing diagram · Claim

Make the claim match the observation.

Forty engineering samples were assembled; six were bench tested. None went to customers. The preliminary emissions check passed, while the full qualification programme remains unfinished.

Six connector sleeves form a symbolic probe assembly. Position indicates conceptual order, not duration, wiring or a measured signal.

before.text:
ADA MENSAH / LOCAL CONCEPT STUDIES

Firmware decisions.
Physical observations.

Three scroll sketches for Mosslink. Choose the object and story structure before we build the full portfolio.

The bring-up fixture ↗

A bench checklist, carried by six contact modules. Recommended.

Inside the power cycle ↗

A state table, carried by six sensor-enclosure sections.

Follow the observation ↗

A timing diagram, carried by six probe connector sleeves.

All geometry is explanatory. These sketches contain no actual device wiring, firmware timing, measured traces or proof of results.
